recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If PA still wants the richer Encounter.type sample code set, follow up through UP-350 or a successor UTG/THO proposal rather than patching the core Encounter source directly.
issue_request: FHIR-14307 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for FHIR-core Encounter. It asked to clarify Encounter.class as "Classification of patient encounter context - e.g. Inpatient, outpatient", clarify Encounter.type as "Specific type of encounter (e.g. e-mail consultation, surgical day-care, ...)", and propose a new Encounter.type value set because the prior examples were misleading.
initial_application: The PA minutes and Jira snapshot record a 5-0-0 approval on 2019-05-29. PR HL7/fhir#2415, merged 2022-09-21, applied the source wording with commits ced07cd59b and 1f9b10954f. The same application path filed UP-350 for the Encounter.type value-set proposal.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml already has the requested short descriptions and binds Encounter.type to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-type. UP-350 remains unresolved in UTG/THO, so the value-set proposal is external and not final enough for a FHIR core source edit. Later related PA decisions FHIR-31399 and FHIR-32341 are already represented on the combined branch and do not reverse this clarification.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No current FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-14307.
